title: Independent review verdict file ($EV/reviews/<gate-or-wp>[-<item>][-r<n>].json or $EV/reviews/CPA-merge-<run_id>.json)
description: Format of every [REVIEW] verdict file of tasks.md (docs/21 section 4.4 and IC-46, the plan owner's held-commit rules after the review of commit af664ed0) and of every merge-review file $EV/reviews/CPA-merge-<run_id>.json, the file that the commit-push script itself names in the Awaits-Review: line of a merge commit it made (tasks.md T040, T042; docs/21 IC-53; contracts revision 9). Producer: the reviewing stream ST-REV, never the stream that made the change (FR-023, constitution 11.4.142, 11.4.240). Consumers: the commit-push script stage S6, which releases a held commit (one whose message carries `Awaits-Review: <this file's path>`) only when this file is committed in the main repository's HEAD with verdict GO and its covers_runs lists the held commit's CPA-Run id; stage S5, which refuses a new hold on a file that already holds GO, in the main repository's HEAD or in the same declared change set, and any change to such a file (exit 20, reason verdict_already_go), and refuses a declared GO whose covers_runs lacks a held commit, in the unpushed range of any owned repository, that awaits the file (exit 20, reason verdict_covers_incomplete; contracts revision 9); the register importer of review rows (docs/04 reg_reviews: GO or NO-GO, model and effort). covers_runs lists every commit the review read, each by repository path (`.` for the main repository, otherwise the submodule path from the main repository root), commit sha and the CPA-Run id from that commit's trailer; it may be empty when the reviewed change is not committed yet (a task that commits only after its GO), and such a verdict releases no held commit. model and effort record what actually performed the review (constitution 11.4.209: Opus at xhigh); effort `?` records that the dispatch path could not set or report it (11.4.231(F.2)), never a claimed xhigh. blocking_findings is required (contracts revision 8): 0 on a GO and at least 1 on a NO-GO, so a GO can never carry an open blocking finding or omit the count (docs/16 section 12.2.4 (e); the round-9 content review of commit b9412d06 found a GO without the field VALID). File name: <gate-or-wp>, an optional -<item> for one item of a package (for example WP-39R-code) and an optional -r<n> for a later review iteration, which holds work made after an earlier GO (tasks.md abbreviation table); or CPA-merge-<run_id> for a merge-review file. Every 40-hex commit sha of covers_runs is a bare hex string, which passes the commit-push S2 secret fold only through the hex filter of .secrets.baseline (tasks.md T040a), never through an exemption. Validated only against synthetic fixtures (no verdict file exists yet); see contracts/README.md. The optional fields foreign_outside_candidate (contracts revision 10) and accepted_pins, findings and mutations (contracts revision 11) are typed below; a GO with gate G-PIN requires accepted_pins, which may be empty when no pointer move is accepted (contracts revision 12), and the NO-GO-only field refused_pins (contracts revision 12) lists the pointer moves a G-PIN NO-GO refused; for_verdict (contracts revision 13) names, in a merge-review file accepting a pointer move, the verdict whose pointer run it serves. Other fields a task records (findings, reviewer-authored mutations, gate-specific checks) are allowed. Contracts revision 14: accepted_pins[].sha may be null, which accepts the deletion of that submodule gitlink. Contracts revision 15 adds the optional reviewed_files list (path and file-content sha256 per file a G-GATE review read), which the owner compares when approving the verdict in the owner-installed host entry point cpa-host (tasks.md rev 23 T042, T046, as revised by tasks.md rev 32 and rev 33; contracts revisions 17 and 18, reviewed_files below). Contracts revision 18 (tasks.md rev 33 T042, T046; description only, no keyword changed): the commit-push script has no release mode of its own and no roster of exceptions; the earlier wording that tied this list to such a mode is withdrawn, and what the commit-push script executes is decided only by the owner's approvals in cpa-host. Contracts revision 16 (tasks.md rev 24): gate is a gate id or a non-empty list of gate ids, so one verdict may release paths of several gated classes; S5 of the commit-push script judges each released path net from the released commit and requires that path's gate in the list, matching exact ids.

gate.description: The gate or gates the review passes or refuses, and the work package it reviews (contracts revision 16, tasks.md rev 24 T042: a gate id or a non-empty list of them; before revision 16 a single string). Values: a gate id of the documented set G-DATA, G-GATE, G-PIN, G-CONTRACT, G-AUDIT, G-SECURITY, G-REMOVAL, G-BADGES, G-EXPORT-SYNC, G-DOC-SCOPE, G-DOC-META, G-DOC-LINKS, G-DOC-FAQ-SOURCE and G-FINAL (tasks.md and docs/21 name them; a new gate id is added there, not here), or a free work-package id such as WP-04. One verdict may hold and release paths of several gated classes of scripts/repo/path_gates.tsv when its list holds every gate they require (class gitlink: G-PIN with a matching accepted_pins entry; class cpa_code and the other G-GATE rows: G-GATE). The commit-push stage S5 matches exact ids, never prefixes or case variants, and counts a missing gate, an empty list or a non-string element as a mismatch (exit 20 verdict_gate_mismatch); a string value is read as a one-element list. Which gates a verdict needs is the consumers' rule, not this schema's.

author.description: the stream that produced the reviewed change; the register importer refuses a verdict whose author equals its reviewer (docs/04 reg_reviews), a cross-field rule JSON Schema cannot express

reviewer.description: the reviewing stream or agent, never the producing stream

repository.description: `.` or a path relative to the main repository root, no leading or trailing slash

cpa_run.description: the run id of the commit's `CPA-Run:` trailer: UTC start time to the second, process id, random suffix

blocking_findings.description: number of blocking findings open at this verdict: 0 on a GO, at least 1 on a NO-GO (constitution 11.4.134: a review iterates to zero blocking findings)

foreign_outside_candidate.description: contracts revision 10 (tasks.md rev 12 T308a, T582, T583; docs/21 IC-58): optional, written only in the merge-review file of a main-repository merge made after the T566 release candidate was built whose incoming range is made only of another actor's commits (no CPA-Run trailer); one entry per such commit that changes a non-test path, with those paths (paths relative to the main repository root); the listed commits are the main repository's ODG-41 kind, never a reason to withhold the merge's GO; an empty list states that no such commit changes a non-test path

items.description: a non-test path that the commit changes, relative to the main repository root, no leading or trailing slash

accepted_pins.description: Per accepted pointer move, the exact gitlink sha the reviewer accepted and the record of the move that produced it (contracts revision 11, revised 12; tasks.md rev 18 T441, T442, T442a, T580a, T581, T440c). Required on every GO whose gate is G-PIN or, from contracts revision 16, a list that includes G-PIN (the layer verdicts WP-55-L<n>.json, WP-73-pins.json and their -r<k> iterations) and on every merge-review GO that accepts a pointer move (it then carries gate G-PIN and, per merged path, the merge sha with move_record = the merge run id); an empty list is allowed and states that the review accepts no pointer move, so no pointer run follows it (revision 12). The commit-push option --accepted-pins (T442a) reads the named verdict, its highest-numbered GO iteration and every merge-review file in the main repository's HEAD whose for_verdict names that verdict (revision 13), using only files with verdict GO and gate G-PIN, and compares every staged gitlink at S2, and at S6 the net gitlink change of the outgoing range per remote tip (a gitlink whose new sha a reachable remote tip of main already holds being exempt; no per-commit check), with the accepted sha of its path: the entry whose sha descends from every other (git merge-base --is-ancestor); a missing list, a missing entry, a sha mismatch or entries with no such maximum are refused with exit 20 (accepted_pins_missing, accepted_pins_entry_missing, accepted_pins_mismatch, accepted_pins_ambiguous).

path.description: gitlink path relative to the main repository root (a nested gitlink by its full path), no leading or trailing slash

sha.description: the accepted 40-hex gitlink sha, or null for the deletion of a submodule gitlink (contracts revision 14; tasks.md T042 S5): null is meaningful only for a path whose gitlink the accepted move deletes

move_record.description: the op id of the helper move (T435a, T435c), the CPA run id of the --repo commit or merge run, or the ledger reference of the move's ev/1 entry

findings.description: Optional list of the review's findings (contracts revision 11). finding_layer is the defect layer of the finding in the closed evidence-class order of constitution 11.4.226 (source < artifact < runtime), required per finding because the custody chain of tasks.md T322 and T457 reads it.

item.description: register item id the finding is linked to, where one exists

mutations.description: Optional record of the mutations the review ran (constitution 11.4.194(6)(d)): at least one reviewer-authored mutation where a test or gate is reviewed. A merge-review file made after the T594 final anchor (the T595a run) records its T308a mutation only here, never in the ledger (contracts revision 11).

refused_pins.description: Optional, contracts revision 12 (tasks.md rev 18 T580a (c), T580c): on a G-PIN NO-GO, the pointer moves the review refused under the candidate rule, each with its path, the exact sha a candidate re-cut must be built with, and the reason; T580c builds the re-cut's scratch clone from exactly these entries.

for_verdict.description: Contracts revision 13 (tasks.md rev 19 T442a): in a merge-review file that accepts a pointer move, the verdict file whose pointer run it serves (for example $EV/reviews/WP-55-L6.json or $EV/reviews/WP-73-pins.json); the commit-push option --accepted-pins reads only merge-review files whose for_verdict names the verdict it was given or one of its -r<k> iterations. Required on a merge-review GO that carries accepted_pins (a cross-field rule on the file name JSON Schema cannot check; consumers check it).

reviewed_files.description: Contracts revision 15 (tasks.md rev 23 T042, T046, T047): the files a G-GATE review read, each by its path from the main repository root and the sha256 of its file content (never a git blob id), one entry per file of every G-GATE row of scripts/repo/path_gates.tsv that the review covers (every file that scripts/repo/cpa_code.txt names, that list, path_gates.tsv, the host entry point scripts/repo/host_entry/cpa-host with its INSTALL.md, and the other G-GATE rows). Contracts revision 17 (tasks.md rev 32 T042, T046, T046a, T094c; description only, no keyword changed): this list is what the owner approves in the owner-installed host entry point cpa-host (cpa-host --owner-trust approve <verdict>), which refuses with exit 20 approval_content_mismatch unless every listed file's content has the listed sha256 (and, for a project's first approval, the list holds scripts/commit-push-all.sh and scripts/review/check_review_provenance.sh), and on the owner's confirmation copies each listed file into its content-addressed store and sets that path's entry in the project's approved manifest; a commit-push run executes only those approved copies and admits at S2 an unheld file of a G-GATE row whose file-content sha256 equals its approved manifest entry. Optional in the schema: that a G-GATE GO carries it, and that it lists every file of the G-GATE rows, is checked by the review (T046) and by cpa-host, not by this schema. Contracts revision 16 (tasks.md rev 24 T042, round-23 review M7): a file that scripts/repo/cpa_code.txt names but the reviewed tree lacks has no entry here (an entry for an absent file fails the approve content comparison). The G-GATE GO this field belongs to may carry gate as a list that includes G-GATE. Contracts revision 18 (tasks.md rev 33 T042 central decision C6; description only, no keyword changed): every G-GATE verdict lists here the path and file-content sha256 of every G-GATE path held on it (for example build/containers/images.lock.yaml, a check's command file, its scripts/repo/cpa_code.txt line and its scripts/repo/validate_checks.tsv row); cpa-host --owner-trust approve, before any confirmation prompt, refuses with exit 20 approval_not_gate_go unless the verdict parses and holds verdict GO, blocking_findings 0, a gate list holding G-GATE and a reviewed_files array of path and sha256 pairs, and with exit 20 reviewed_files_incomplete naming each G-GATE path that a commit of covers_runs changes against its first parent and that this list lacks; after the adoption the conductor passes --commit with the verdict's GO introduction commit. The provenance record of a verdict <name>.json is <name>.provenance.json beside it.

path.description: file path relative to the main repository root, no leading or trailing slash

sha256.description: lowercase 64-hex sha256 of the file content
